We would like to showcase some monsters that we’ve been working on recently. Our goal is to have a diverse bestiary that will keep you on your toes regardless of the biome you’re currently exploring.

Rats
Fast and dangerous minions of skeletons. Often encountered in dungeons. Be careful not to get swarmed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/d0321215dce35ce668a95c481daa23d42590e8da.gif

Worms
Encountered in Rotten biome. They keep you at distance with ranged spitting attacks, and explode when you get too close. Very dangerous.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/cf69a0d0d7aef27bc55a5def54d8155b18853158.gif


Bat
A flying menace, an aggressive aerial monster often encountered in dark places.

notes.title: 🪂 Soar the Skies: Gliders & Launchers Update
notes.content:
Hey Explorers,


In this week’s update, let us tell you a bit about another way of transportation - a hang glider (also referred to simply as “Glider”), and its Launcher.

What is the Launcher?
The Launcher is a powerful device that propels players high into the air, enabling them to deploy their Glider to travel between the floating islands. As a technological marvel, these devices are exclusively located on islands with Steamer race structures. They are powered by yellow crystals called a “Crystal of Ignition”.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfzosb8-Tv8zM1FvKIc-A0KDuARGrtYqk17N-CZ1ysitVyTZGRwSjjzMbdMFl5Uf4pklUZ7UEWR6KbZn0uvDbiCRee5ivghvVpU0bPeSK3aoDTKrIsqfHvc7tdhoZUutup3tl1rcg?key=4uKtq924UtDt6uojr7-rgQ"]


How to Use It?
Using the Launcher is straightforward but requires specific preparation:
[olist]
Step Inside: Position yourself on the central platform within the device.

Crystal of Ignition: Ensure you have a Crystal of Ignition in your inventory.

Activate: Interact with the device to trigger the launch sequence.
[/olist]
Once activated, the Launcher consumes the Crystal of Ignition and after a brief delay, propels you skyward with tremendous force, sending you soaring into the air. Then, if you have a Glider equipped, simply press SpaceBar and start flying.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfu0B3mClsro2mJqqbvf-QTSTOQHS4PnRTSYZacZNLXA6htLPP1QOXOxfqas2AS3f44A2_1TYZx5ZT9PlRUlPrtQTGPijO6Ht_i800ZHDp7as_YhgRFll-EkdHidnen3tOBHyAj9Q?key=4uKtq924UtDt6uojr7-rgQ"]


Obtaining and Controlling a Glider
The Glider needs to be crafted - to obtain the recipe, thoroughly explore the Steamer ruins!

While flying, you can use WSAD to make the Glider fly forward, backward, and slightly turn right or left. The Glider's movement is not connected to the direction you're looking, meaning you can look around approximately 180 degrees while controlling it.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXepSXXH6yPA3T0-K7YmQOC-brS9a_88wRxt8h57lBk26kBtx2jma-TNofuIl51rcxgqB4jgPX5FLh3nd5_4SBbQ1cdNLgA2wMXMEZIIBNkIILk0UuRMEUh1soUeZEf4HIFMgglGBw?key=4uKtq924UtDt6uojr7-rgQ"]



As always, we hope you enjoyed this preview, and you’re looking forward to soaring through the skies in your very own hang glider.

notes.title: A First Look at Merchants in the World of Everwind
notes.content:
Hey Explorers,

We know that some of you were worried that our stretch goal, NPC Settlements, will be scrapped because we didn’t reach it. Rest assured that this idea was not abandoned and might make a resurgence eventually - what’s more, today’s topic is directly related to content that was planned for it! Enjoy Studio proudly presents: currency and merchants.


Coins: Your Currency


Coins are the universal currency used to buy and sell items with merchants. They can be found scattered in dungeons, or received as payment when you offload your unwanted gear and resources.

They will buy everything, but pay considerably more for their favourite items!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/10ea15b05aca98c5b330282bdde53af1ea4d0e7e.png
Pricing Mechanics[olist]
Item Quality: Level, durability %, modifiers, and special effects all influence price.

Merchant Interest: Each merchant values certain categories more highly - this adjusts buying and selling rates.

Supply Limits: Merchants hold a finite amount of coins. Buying from you replenishes their funds; selling to them drains it.
[/olist]
Pro Tip: You can always repurchase items you’ve sold - but merchants charge a premium on buy‑back, so plan accordingly!

Merchants’ inventories and coin reserves reset and any sold‑out items vanish if you go too far from their location.



Loot vs. Shop Drops
Defeating a merchant in combat drops random loot related to their profession. For example, an Alchemist can drop any potion. However, items that they purchased from you are not part of their loot tables, so no bullying merchants to get your stuff back!

How to Trade
[olist]
Approach a merchant and press Interact.

The trading window opens: your inventory is on the left, the merchant’s on the right.

Hover over any item to see its buying or selling price (if the merchant window is closed, you’ll see only the base price).

Click an item to buy or sell - it’s that simple! Coins and items transfer instantly.
[/olist]

notes.title: Plant, Chill, Repeat!
notes.content:
Hey Explorers,
We’ve been focusing on combat and navigation quite a bit recently, so in today’s post, we’ll dive into everything you need to know about planting, nurturing, and harvesting crops in the game. 

Basic Farming Workflow

1.	Find a Seedling
Locate the seedling of the plant you want to grow. You’ll find details on its needs in your Compendium once you’ve collected it.  
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/c8472126a1486064324f35be433d9ea3adfd3899.png

2.	Prepare a Pot
Craft or place a flowerpot as your planting container.

3.	Add the Right Soil
Fill the pot with the specific soil type required by your seedling—check the item tooltip or Compendium for details.

4.	Plant the Seedling
Place your seedling into the prepared pot.

5.	Water Your Plant
Give it a good soak. Keep an eye on the hydration meter—moisture naturally decreases over time. 

6.	Mind the Altitude
Keep in mind that altitude matters—each plant thrives at its own ideal elevation. If any of the three conditions (soil, watering, altitude) aren’t met, your plant will eventually rot and die.

Tip: Every time you tend your garden, double-check that soil, water level, and altitude are all within the required ranges—when everything’s right, tiny sprouts will start to appear after a short while; if something’s off, the seedling will dull in color.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/0932708d311bdf2860bc2262f9869f5ae1a4a7a8.gif
 
Advanced Gardening: Incubators
Once you reach a higher farming tier, you can craft an Incubator   instead of using pots. The incubator automatically bypasses the altitude requirement, letting you farm anywhere—even at extreme heights!

Where to Find Plant Requirements
●	Compendium Entries: After harvesting a seedling, open your Compendium to view its exact soil, water, and altitude needs.

●	Item Tooltip: Hover over the seedling item in your inventory for a quick summary of its requirements.
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/ca2627e094562e4d1c14fc67dd592611454b927c.gif

Continuous Harvests
Did you know? As long as your plant remains within its growth conditions, it can regrow multiple yields without needing to be replanted. Just water it, monitor its status, and reap the rewards again and again!

That’s all for today’s green-thumb guide. We hope you enjoyed this look into a more cozy part of Everwind. See you soon!

notes.title: Early-game companion: the Boat.
notes.content:
Hello Explorers!
We’re doing something different today - instead of showcasing mid or late game, we will tell you about your soon-to-be favourite early-game companion: the Boat.

🎯 Purpose and Role of the Boat

The Boat is your basic early-game water transport. It lets you quickly travel between nearby islands. It serves as a gateway to further exploration, as you will need to use it to obtain the right materials before unlocking your flying ship. Your Boat will offer a faster, more enjoyable early-game experience, as opposed to slowly swimming between islands yourself. However, if you choose the latter, be aware that there is no diving in the game, so going under the water is a one way trip!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/c15b74edaa14c94472e51e5906656ba21e661f4a.gif

🔧 How It Works

To set sail, you’ll need to gather the basic materials—sturdy planks of wood, rope, and nails—before assembling your boat at a crafting station. There are no complex sailing mechanics involved in sailing your Boat - simply choose a direction and speed and enjoy the ride. You don’t have to wrestle with complicated sails or rigging; instead, your focus remains on the horizon and the beckoning silhouettes of distant isles. Once you’re confident at sea, you can acquire your flying ship and soar into the skies.

Let us know if you’re looking forward to some boating!

notes.title: Isles of Hope: Discover the Last Human Settlements
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,
Today, we will talk about people and their struggles in the world of Urthia, who survive against all odds. These are the last human survivors—farmers and settlers who lived on the kingdom’s edges before Maester’s experiments turned people into skeletons. They live alone on floating islands, far from the capital, safe from the undead plague. They grow their own food and can’t leave their tiny sky-worlds.

When exploring the world of Everwind, you’ll find three types of villages:

Thriving Towns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/1661530375a95f4ab6adce4bb38904b8c29b974e.png

Fancy buildings, a town hall, taverns and decorated homes. Here you’ll meet the best merchants, blacksmiths and craftsmen. They’ll trade rare items with you and can repair or upgrade your weapons.

Frontier Hamlets

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/e5fe94e1f36c53e2d5c34a215a1d8008304256c5.png

Simple wooden houses and farms. You’ll find farmers and a few specialists—a jeweler, a tailor, an herbalist—all ready to trade.

Ruined Outposts

Broken buildings and old notes tell of past wars. Only a few lonely survivors live here, having seen no one else for years.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/fcdb7233cca98afb4f34a53806260071094e4826.png

Every building has its own interior, and winding paths connect homes and shops. There are nine kinds of NPC traders: general merchant, innkeeper, jeweler, blacksmith, armorer, herbalist, tailor, carpenter and fletcher. They let you sell loot and buy special gear. Additionally, they enable unique services - for example, a blacksmith can also repair and upgrade your equipment, and what’s more, interacting with these people is the only way to obtain unique building blocks and furniture.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/bbaa66eb72210649f93ece1bb9f28cb8416de0a5.png

Some villages have armored guards who will attack you if you steal or kill. So think twice before looting a town! What’s more, we are still thinking of other ways to make sure that the player will not be able to get away with mischief. Prepare to be surprised.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/43468bc8309558f7908208c05abf473c24eed7e0.png

The swallow is the enduring emblem of these people—once a sign of freedom and peace, it was defiled by the skeletal hordes who chipped away at its shape. Now its restored silhouette marks every human stronghold. You, a bold outsider who has mastered steamer-tech and can traverse the skies, are viewed as a destined hero—both a curiosity and a savior to the islanders who revere your skills. Will you help them reclaim their world… or forge your own legend amid the clouds?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/c3ff32bd1a616fc5adf4a8bc896a1fb99043f18d.png

This content is a part of our “NPC Settlements” stretch goal. We are very grateful for all the support so far. There are still 7 days to reach it, so let’s bring it home together!

notes.title: 🔥 Dev Update: Introducing the Magical Compass – Your Lifeline in Urthia! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Since the moment we launched our Kickstarter campaign, your support has absolutely blown us away. The enthusiasm and passion from our growing community have been incredible—especially the conversations happening across social media about Urthia and its unique mechanics.

Today, as a heartfelt thank you, we’re excited to unveil one of the most essential tools you’ll wield in your journey through Urthia:

🧭 The Magical Compass 🧭
A small device with big power—and your best friend when the skies get rough.

✨ What Is the Magical Compass?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/ff698ea30d882d3ee153ae32b98d82b80211e182.gif

Forged from burnished brass and ancient, riveted steel, the Magical Steamer-Compass is a fusion of arcane power and clockwork precision. Suspended in a miniaturized gyroscopic cradle, its floating needle spins with a soft hiss of steam, always pointing you toward home—your island’s spawn rudder.

Once it’s in your hands, it’s yours forever. Bound to you. Trusty. Eternal.

[previewyoutube=4Hn_N4z0Htw;full][/previewyoutube]

📖 A Glimpse into the Lore
Long ago, the alien Steamers crafted this incredible device for their own use—fusing otherworldly gear-steel with arcane resonance. Deep within its core beats the light of a Yellow Ignition Crystal, glowing with a ceaseless inner fire.

Etched in mysterious patterns not native to Urthia, the Magical Compass hums with a quiet mechanical purpose. It’s more than a tool—it’s a symbol of connection, guidance, and survival.

🎮 How It Works (In-Game Mechanics)
Always With You: The Magical Compass is a bound artifact. Once acquired, it permanently resides in your inventory. No losing it. No tossing it away.

Find Your Way: The needle always points to your island's spawn rudder, no matter how far you stray.

Homeward Vent: Activate the compass to initiate teleportation. After a short sequence, you'll reappear safely on your spawn platform.

🛠️ Survival Scenarios: Why It Matters
Ever been…

😱 Chased by a horde of wild monsters?
😵 Lost in a sprawling dungeon?
🪂 Flung off a floating island or soared too far on your glider?

Don’t panic.
The Magical Compass is your lifeline. Activate it and you’re back home, safe and sound.

Whether you're exploring distant ruins or dodging danger in the clouds, the Magical Compass is your steam-powered guardian—always humming softly by your side, ready to guide you home.

If you want to support us, our Kickstarter is still open; 
Let’s build the world of Everwind—together.

notes.title: Everwind Kickstarter Launch and Devlog 3
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Big news from the skies of Everwind! 🚀
We’re thrilled to announce that our Kickstarter campaign is now live, and with it, we’re unveiling a deeper look into the world we’ve been building with passion and care.

To celebrate this exciting milestone, Devlog 3 has just landed! 🎥
This new video takes you inside Everwind’s rich lore, unique civilizations, terrifying enemies, deep crafting mechanics, your very own customizable flying airship, and more.

🔗 Watch Devlog 3 now: 

[previewyoutube=h_m5nvKDOOM;full][/previewyoutube]

🛠️ Build, Fly, and Thrive — Your Airship Awaits
In Everwind, your airship isn’t just for travel — it’s your floating fortress in the skies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/e5bad1a939bd428cce3eb436ca27745cbe7fda6e.gif

🛠 Customize everything — Add rooms, tunnels, and structures.
🎨 Make it yours — Decorate and design to reflect your style.
⚙️ Key components include:


 Helm – Your control center for direction and thrust.
 Energy Generator – Powers your systems with fuel or water.
 Balloons – Lift your ship higher (fuel required).
 Engines – Propel you forward across vast skylands.
 Pipe System – Connects everything for smooth operations.


💡 Pro tip: The more you build, the heavier your ship becomes — balance design with efficiency to reach greater heights!

Choose Your Path — Classes & Skill Trees
Your journey is yours to shape. Level up and invest in a dynamic skill tree with three unique classes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/c868ab55d04ef5f695803e979a9373b5f76f7340.png

🔴 Warrior – Master of melee and survival. Boost damage, speed, and armor. Unlock deadly strikes and combat finesse.

🔧 Engineer – The crafter’s dream. Unlock rare blueprints, enhance mechanisms, and create high-tier gear.

🔮 Arcanist – Wield mystical powers. Brew potent potions, enchant gear, and master magical weaponry.

💫 Mix and match skills to craft a playstyle that’s uniquely yours!

 Enemies & Civilizations — What Lurks in the Skies?
The world of Everwind is teeming with danger and wonder. As you explore, you’ll encounter civilizations both ancient and arcane:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/95b05b5796c97100635ac18d5188869c59dab0fd.png
🏰 The Skeletons – Masters of metal and stone, these undead dwell in towering fortresses and shadowy ruins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/eda6cb39567b49466acd75c2a08ce3856517d5bb.png
🤖 The Steamers – High-tech and mysterious, these robotic beings hold secrets that may change everything.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/f89e0d78b4d16c396ba6cadafd0a0ad754862063.png
🌿 The Goblins – The oldest race on the continent. Jungle-dwelling, magically gifted... and not to be trusted.

🌱 Farming Among the Clouds

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/fd6a5bf8aeaf7ca1289677c19af9b8885e596e7c.png

Turn your airship into a floating garden!
Explore biomes, gather rare plants, and grow everything from basic foods to powerful potion ingredients — if you have the soil and setup.

🍃 Farming isn’t just cozy—it’s strategic.

What’s Next? The Road Ahead
Check out our Kickstarter page for full details, lore, and behind-the-scenes info.
And yes—we’ve just released our official roadmap so you know exactly what’s coming next! 🔮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/4f4443d5a2a4d1f1af571df0631c3996abbedfde.png

Got something you’d love to see in Everwind? Let us know in the comments — your feedback shapes our journey.

🚀 Why Kickstarter?
This campaign isn’t about finishing the game—it’s about expanding it.

By backing us, you’re helping unlock new features, exclusive content, and joining a growing community of passionate explorers.

There are no barriers to forming your perfect crew and embarking on an unforgettable journey.

We’ll be revealing more details soon, including the official launch date and our funding goals. This is your chance to be part of SkyVerse’s development and help shape the game’s future—so stay tuned!

notes.title: DevLog#2 : Combat Mechanics
notes.content:
SkyVerse Dev-Log: Let’s Talk Combat!

Hey there, adventurers!
Welcome back to another SkyVerse dev-log. 
If you missed the first one where we explored the game’s biomes, go check it out it’s a great intro to the infinite, blocky world of flying islands we’re building. 

Today, we’re diving into something a little more action-packed: combat.

[previewyoutube=7kOagdI6Nd4;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore, Fight, and Loot!

SkyVerse is all about exploring floating islands, gathering resources, and uncovering secrets. Along the way, you’ll stumble upon dungeons filled with enemies and treasures. Some are easy to spot on the surface, while others are hidden deep underground, packed with traps, puzzles, and epic loot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/e5b2f4573280e5455f7889774e6f74fdffc24daa.gif
 
Pick Your Weapon

The arsenal in SkyVerse will be highly diverse, offering numerous types of weapons you can craft or find as loot. Weapon categories include:

•	One-Handed Weapons: Good balance of speed and damage, plus you can use a shield.
•	Two-Handed Weapons: Slower but hit like a truck.
•	Daggers: Super quick for rapid strikes.
•	Bows: Attack from a distance (don’t forget to stock up on arrows!).
•	Magic Staff: Cast spells and bring some magic to the fight.

We also plan to introduce two new weapon types, which will remain a secret for now. Though many details may change before the game’s release, one thing is certain – the quantity and variety of weaponry will not disappoint!

Combat Mechanics.

Every swing, slash, or spell costs stamina, so you’ll need to keep an eye on that stamina bar. Run out mid-fight, and you might have to back off, catch your breath, or chow down on some food or potions to get back in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/6291ee8b77060f46324dbc8ad622b848f99a0092.gif

Weapon handling is simple and intuitive:

Just click the left mouse button for a single attack. Feeling fancy? String together four quick clicks to perform a combo—a chain of rapid strikes that temporarily boosts your attack speed.

And for those of you who like to pack a punch, most weapons (except for magic staves and bows) have a heavy attack. Just hold down the attack button to charge up a devastating blow. It uses more stamina but deals serious damage and can even stun enemies. Plus, your heavy attack animations change based on how you’re moving—charge forward, sweep sideways, or strike as you retreat. It’s all about bringing the drama to the battlefield!

Each weapon has several attributes affecting its combat effectiveness:

•	Damage: Determines how much health you take from an enemy with each hit.
•	Critical Damage Chance: Higher values increase the likelihood of landing powerful critical hits with bonus damage.
•	Durability: Weapons degrade during use, especially when blocking attacks. Damaged weapons can be repaired at repair stations or with repair tools anywhere.

Ready to test your skills? Let’s go!

Gear Up for Adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876231/5afbc863cc3355e95458250d4af5f2a03d8e1441.gif

Armor is just as important as your weapons. You’ll have helmets, gloves, boots, and even gliders to help you explore the skies. Gear can be upgraded and enchanted to boost your defense, and Weapons can also feature magical attributes and upgrades to enhance their combat capabilities by adding effects like freezing enemies or causing bleed damage.

What’s Next?

We’re still tweaking combat, adding enemies, working on implementing wildlife and much more.

https://skyverse.gg/images/boar_800.gif
 
Also, we will soon be launching our Kickstarter campaign  in March, to help us support game development, so stay tuned as we are planning to share more exciting news very soon, and maybe a new trailer!  

https://skyverse.gg/images/kick.png

Join our socials and make sure you don't miss out on anything!

notes.title: DevLog#1 Biomes and World
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,
We’re excited to kick off the first of many Devlogs, where we’ll take you behind the scenes of our game development journey. We’ll dive into upcoming plans, future updates, and, of course, give you some amazing sneak peeks at what’s in store.
Let’s get straight to it.

Different biomes in the SkyVerse World:

[previewyoutube=KlpMK7aB8Ks;full][/previewyoutube]

During the month of October, we presented you with 3 different biomes from the world of SkyVerse : The Forest, The Jungle, and Rotten.
We are now ready to give you more insights about each biomes and what to expect from them:

1. The Forest:
The forest biome is where your adventure begins! It stretches across islands floating in the air and on the ocean, in the lowest parts of the world. Most of these islands are covered in dense forests, rich with essential resources for your development. In these forests, you'll find an abundance of mushrooms, fruits, and vegetables, along with various animals – from adorable capybaras to menacing undead skeletons who have made the forest their stronghold. But don’t worry! The forest is the most ordinary biome in the SkyVerse universe!

2. Rotten lands:
The Rotten biome is a place that stands in stark contrast to the vibrant, colorful forest. The ground is toxic, plants are decayed, and the atmosphere... feels heavy and oppressive. These islands surely hide a dark history within. Here, you'll find industrial structures made from an unknown type of metal—massive constructions filled with mechanisms and technology that you might just be able to master.

3. Jungle Biome:
The Jungle Biome is a place where it’s incredibly easy to lose your way! The dense forest hides one of the three civilizations inhabiting our universe (though we won’t reveal which one just yet!). Hidden high up in the clouds, this biome is infused with magic that flows through both the plants and the inhabitants, who know exactly how to harness it. The climate allows unique plants to flourish, and the lush vegetation often conceals relics of this place's past. Stay alert! One wrong step, and you might find yourself in ancient, underground structures!

Combat system teaser

To finish up the biome description, here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in the next Dev-log. Right now, we’re working on the combat system, one of the game’s main mechanics. SkyVerse is all about RPG elements, so using weapons well will be very important. You’ll have different types of weapons, each with its own style. There will also be ranged options—bows and magical staffs that can cast different spells. All this and more coming soon!

What's coming next ?

Now it’s time to ramp up our first DevBlog, but do not worry as we are planning to release more news about the game development in the future so stay tuned.
If you want to make sure not to miss anything join us on our official social media:

We can’t wait for you to experience all of these exciting new additions yourself. However, keep in mind that this content is still in development, so things may change before the official release.
